translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Med'inaa Goday hewaappe guyye Noha hawaadan yaageedda; «Neeni ne soo asaa ubbaanna markkabiyaa giddo gela; ayaw gooppe, taani ha wodiyaa yeletaa giddon neeni s'illo gideeddawaa be'aaddi.

Neeni geeshsha gideedda mehiyaanne do'aa ubbaappe Aa k'ommuwaappe k'ommuwaappe attumawaanne mac'c'awaa laappunuwaa laappunuwaa, geeshsha gidenna mehiyaanne do'aa ubbaappe Aa k'ommuwaappe k'ommuwaappe itti attumawaanne itti mac'c'awaa, k'ay saluwaa kafuwaappe Aa k'ommuwaappe k'ommuwaappe attumawaanne mac'c'awaa laappunuwaa laappunuwaa ootsaade, sa'aa ubbaa bollan dumma dumma zeretsay shemppuwaanna attana mala neenana akkaade gela.
Ayaw gooppe, laappun gallassaappe guyye, taani oytamu gallassaanne oytamu k'ammaa ha sa'aa bollan iraa bukissana; yaataade taani med'd'eedda med'etaa ubbaa sa'aa bollaappe d'ayssana» yaageedda.
Nohe Med'inaa Goday Aa azazeedda ubbabaa ootseedda.
Bashshaa haatsay ha sa'aa bolla yeedda wode, Nohe laytsay usuppun s'eeta.
Nohe, Aa attuma naanay, Aa machatanne Aa naanaa machchetuu bashshaa haatsaappe attanaw markkabiyaa giddo geleeddino.
Geeshsha mehiyaappenne do'aappe, geeshsha gidenna mehiyaappenne do'aappe, kafuwaappenne biittaana gooshettiyaawanttu ubbaappe
S'oossay Noha azazeeddawaadankka attumawenne mac'c'awe laa"uwaa laa"uwaa gidi, Nohekko yiide markkabiyaa giddo geleeddino.
Laappun gallassaappe guyye, bashshaa haatsay ha sa'aa bollan yeedda.

Nohe usuppun s'eetu laytsaa de'ina, laa"entsa aginaan, tammanne laappuntsa gallassan, he gallassan biittaa giddon de'iyaa wolk'k'aama c'iimmaa pulttuwaa ubbay d'uuk'k'i aggeeda; saluwaan de'iyaa haatsaa penggetuukka dooyetti wod'd'eeddino;
Iray ha sa'aa bollan oytamu gallassaanne oytamu k'ammaa bukkeedda.
He gallassan Nohenne Aa attuma naanay, Seeme, Kaamenne Yaafeeti, Nohe machatanne Aa naanaa heezzatuwaa machatuu ittippe markkabiyaa giddo geleeddino.

Unttunttune do'aa ubbaappe bare k'ommuwaan k'ommuwaan, mehiyaa ubbaappe bare k'ommuwaan k'ommuwaan, sa'aanna gooshettiyaawanttu ubbaappe bare k'ommuwaan k'ommuwaan, kafuwaa ubbaappe bare k'ommuwaan k'ommuwaan, unttunttunna ittippe geleeddino;
de'uwaa shemppuwaanna de'iyaawanttu ubbay laa"uwaa laa"uwaa gidi, Nohekko yiide markkabiyaan geleeddino;
S'oossay Noha azazeeddawaadan, med'etaa ubbaappe attumawaanne mac'c'awaa gidiide, markkabiyaa giddo geli simmowaan, Med'inaa Goday markkabiyaa penggiyaa gorddeedda.
Bashshaa haatsay oytamu gallassaa sa'aa bollan bukkiidde gam"eedda; haatsay dariide, markkabiyaa biittappe pude dentseedda.
Haatsay biittaa bollan loytsi darina, markkabii haatsaa bollan tooketteedda.
Saluwaappe garssaana de'iyaa d'ok'k'a deretuu ubbay mitettana gakkanaw, haatsay ha sa'aa bollan loytsi wolk'k'aappe dareedda.
Haatsay deretuwaa s'eeraappe aad'd'iide, tammanne ichcheshu wad'aa gakkanaw tookeedda.
Yaatina sa'aa bollan shemppuwaanna k'aas's'iyaa med'etatuu ubbay: kafuu, mehii, do'ay, sa'aa bollan sham"i giyaa med'etaa ubbaynne Asay ubbay hayk'k'eedda.
Ee, mela biittaa bollan de'iyaa, bare siid'iyaan de'uwaa shemppuwaa shemppiyaa ubbaykka hayk'k'eedda.

Ha sa'aan pas'a de'iyaabay ubbay: asay, mehiinne do'ay, biittaana gooshettiyaa med'etatuunne saluwaa kafotuu ubbaykka sa'aappe d'ayeeddino. Nohe s'alalaynne aanana markkabiyaa giddon de'iyaawanttu atteeddino.
He haatsay s'eetanne ishatamu gallassaa gakkanaw sa'aa bollan gam"eedda.
